title: Updated doc for image and icon shapes
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

- Updated Documentation for Mermaid Flowcharts to include new special shapes: **icon** and **image**.
- Separate out documentation for registering icon pack in mermaid. Added link in side-bar in config section.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [X] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [ ] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.
author: saurabhg772244

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: We should move the icon document out of syntax/architecture, not that it's available in other diagrams.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Use the relative URLs of the md file, instead of html link. It will be replaced automatically. 

You can refer `packages/mermaid/src/docs/config/usage.md` as an example.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Please move this below `Mermaid Configuration Options`

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
Could we switch to an icon pack that is available on our site, e.g.

```suggestion
    A@{ icon: "logos:zod", form: "square", label: "User Icon", pos: "t", h: 60 }
```

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/825b0665-09c2-43ad-b193-b1cbb6fc7b9e)

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
This image URL is invalid and causes an error.

Could we maybe switch to an image already hosted on our site, e.g.

```suggestion
    A@{ img: "https://mermaid.js.org/favicon.svg", label: "Image Label", pos: "t", w: 60, h: 60, constraint: "off" }
```

(although, `w: 60, h:60` doesn't seem to set the image height correctly, for some reason, due to the label)

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e6cc9bc-2658-4c3b-8a15-c90370bcdd70)
